releases.name: Initial public release
releases.body:
## OpenCode V2 Profile Switcher v0.1.0

First public release of OpenCode V2 Profile Switcher.

### Features

- Switch model profiles directly from the TUI or Desktop GUI using `/profile`.
- Configure different models and reasoning efforts for primary agents, subagents, and custom agents.
- Manage complex multi-agent workflows without repeatedly editing agent configurations.
- Switch profiles in existing sessions while preserving conversation history.
- Keep model selection synchronized between the TUI and Desktop GUI.
- Save profile selections per repository.
- Includes six example profiles and a prebuilt GUI extension.

### Compatibility

- **macOS:** Tested and working.
- **Windows & Linux:** Not yet tested on real installations.
- **OpenCode:** V2, compatible with the 2.3.x plugin SDK.

### Installation

```bash
opencode plugin add @ammiiir1/opencode-profile-switcher
```

See the [[README](https://github.com/ammiiir1/opencode-profile-switcher#readme)](https://github.com/ammiiir1/opencode-profile-switcher#readme) for setup instructions, profile examples, and demos.

Found a bug or tested it on Windows or Linux? [[Open an issue](https://github.com/ammiiir1/opencode-profile-switcher/issues)](https://github.com/ammiiir1/opencode-profile-switcher/issues). Contributions and pull requests are welcome.
